items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: That's why I'm wearing glasses, to try to read his music.

ctx.x: Man, his music was just -- he played so many notes. That's why I'm wearing glasses, to try to read his music.

But there just haven't been any openings for the Black Jazz musician. You go to a club, you got to bargain for scale, and that reduces the type of guys you're going to have to have with you, because it's not enough money. But you get a Ruby Braff can go and demand and get whatever he wants, or even Scott Hamilton AND HE'S NEW.
